title: spar-exocortex attacker output envelope
description: Output of Step 2 — Attacker dispatch. Must contain a concrete failing input or named operational failure scenario; verbal-only criticism fails validation.

inputType.description: Failure category. Correctness = wrong output; complexity-blow-up = exceeds claimed complexity on a constructed input; operational-failure = concurrency / state / resource issue.

oneOf.description: Executable input data (for correctness / complexity-blow-up types). Must be parseable by the harness for the target language.

scenario.description: Concrete operational scenario (e.g., 'concurrent read during eviction at cache size N').

trigger.description: Specific operation sequence that triggers the failure.

oneOf.description: Operational-failure scenario (for inputType=operational-failure). Verbal-only criticism without a scenario+trigger fails validation.

failingInput.description: Executable input or concrete operational scenario. Verbal-only criticism is rejected and triggers one re-dispatch.

expectedVsActual.description: What the baseline should produce vs what it produces. For complexity-blow-up: expected = claimed complexity envelope; actual = observed envelope.

argumentWhyBreaks.description: Brief argument tying failingInput to the failure mode. One paragraph max — the input does the work, not the prose.
